description: Oluswayiri lwe lulimi lw’Obuvanjuba bwa Afrika, olwogerwa abantu bukadde na bukadde okuva e Mombasa ne Zanzibar okutuuka e Kampala, Kigali ne Goma.
notes: Drafted by Claude (AI) for the composed lg-sw course (#187): the Luganda needs a native-speaker review. Word and unit notes fall back to the English notes (lang/en/about/sw) until Luganda ones are written.

why.title: Olulimi lw’**Obuvanjuba bwa Afrika bwonna.**
why.text: Oluswayiri lulimi lwa ggwanga mu Kenya, Tanzania ne Uganda, era lwe lwogerwa mu by’obusuubuzi okuva ku lubalama lw’ennyanja okutuuka e Congo. Luyige otambule, osuubule, ofune emikwano era owulire ennyimba, okuva ku taarab okutuuka ku bongo flava.

cards.title: Eri abatambuze
cards.text: Tambula okuva e Mombasa okutuuka e Mwanza mu matatu, daladala oba ku kyombo.

cards.title: Ku mulimu
cards.text: Yogera ne bakozi banno n’abaguzi mu kitundu kyonna.

cards.title: Eri abaagala okumanya
cards.text: Zuula ebika by’amannya, engero n’ebitontome by’oku lubalama eby’emyaka lukumi.

landing.audience: Aboogera Oluganda abatandika okuva ku ntandikwa: abatambuze, abasuubuzi n’abakozi mu Buvanjuba bwa Afrika, n’abayizi abaagala Oluswayiri.
landing.first: Okulamusa n’ekitiibwa, ab’omu maka, emmere n’akatale, ennamba n’essaawa, ebifo n’okutambula, awaka, ennaku za wiiki n’obulamu, ekitundu ku kitundu.

cast.nakato: Omukulembeze wo, omuyizi ku yunivasite e Dar es Salaam
cast.mukasa: Atunda caayi ne capati e Mombasa
cast.jjajja: Jjajja e Zanzibar addamu buli kimu n’olugero
cast.ssali: Omuvuzi wa matatu e Nairobi amanyi buli siteegi
cast.amara: Omuyizi wa siniya e Arusha ayagala bongo flava
cast.emma: Omugenyi okuva ebweru ayiga Oluswayiri nga ggwe
